evidence: The HfO2 deposition was performed at 200°C using tetrakis (dimethylamido)hafnium(IV) and water as the hafnium and oxygen precursors. An optimized ALD cycle comprised a sequence of water pulse/water exposure/water purge/tetrakis pulse/tetrakis exposure/tetrakis purge with time frames of 0.2/5/8/1/5/8 s, respectively.
